07/10/2026.report: A Atzeni stated that he was instructed to go forward but his mount was unable to cross runners to his inside which resulted in it being obliged to race wide and without cover for the majority of the event. He added that BEAUTY SHOW was further disadvantaged when MAPOGO was positioned to his outside which resulted in BEAUTY SHOW then weakening noticeably in the Home Straight. Before being allowed to race again, BEAUTY SHOW will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination which must include additional diagnostic assessments. <14/10/2026 7 October 2026 Happy Valley Racemeeting – Race 5 (83)> Additional diagnostic assessments performed on the horse did not reveal any significant findings.

Trainer F C Lor agreed with the assessment of Jockey Purton that the horse did not appreciate being pressured in the lead but could offer no other explanation for the horse’s performance. A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings. The performance of BEAUTY SHOW, which finished tailed out, was considered unacceptable. Before being allowed to race again, BEAUTY SHOW will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.

21/05/2025.report: H Bowman, the rider of 5th placegetter, MIGHTY COMMANDER, pleaded guilty to a charge under Rule 100(2) in that he failed to ride his mount out to the end of the race to the satisfaction of the Stewards. In assessing penalty the Stewards were satisfied that his actions had compromised the horse’s finishing position. When questioned H Bowman stated that the intention was to hold a more forward position but his mount was bumped at the start and as a result he elected to obtain a trailing position behind JUMBO FORTUNE. He added that in the early stages MIGHTY COMMANDER raced keenly and approaching the 1000 Metres got its head up when being steadied away from SIMPLE HEDGE. After the race an endoscopic examination was conducted on MIGHTY COMMANDER at the request of Trainer C Fownes. The Veterinary Surgeon said this examination showed a substantial amount of blood in the horse’s trachea. Before being allowed to race again, MIGHTY COMMANDER will be subjected to an official veterinary examination. Sent for sampling post-race.

01/11/2026.report: When questioned Apprentice H Y Yuen stated that her instructions were to obtain a midfield position preferably with cover. She said after commencing well she was caught wide in the early stages to the outside of DAZZLING FIT. She said as the field approached the 1400 Metres her mount commenced to race keenly and as a result she was unable to restrain and obtain a position with cover. She added when TURIN CHAMPIONS shifted to a one-off position near the 1100 Metres PRESTIGE GOOD was left racing without cover and as a result continued to race keenly and improved forward despite her efforts to restrain. When questioned if there was an opportunity to allow her mount to stride forward approaching the 1000 Metres to avoid racing wide and to not continue to have to restrain her mount Apprentice Yuen stated that having regard to her instructions which included that she was to obtain cover and not lead, she elected to remain racing wide and without cover until near the 700 Metres. She said as she approached the 700 Metres and her mount continued to race keenly, she then allowed PRESTIGE GOOD to stride forward but then was unable to cross TURIN CHAMPIONS and SAMARKAND, resulting in PRESTIGE GOOD being obliged to race wide and without cover for the majority of the event. Trainer P F Yiu confirmed the instructions were to obtain cover. He said having regard to those instructions he was satisfied with the decision of Apprentice Yuen to not continue forward to lead in the middle stages. After considering her explanation and taking into account her instructions the Stewards advised Apprentice Yuen that, in their opinion, she would have been better suited by allowing her mount to stride forward near the 1000 Metres and attempt to lead to avoid covering additional ground.
